name: Thorndale Jarvis Organization
description: The Thorndale Jarvis Organization (TJO), also known as the Thorndale Jag Offs, was a white greaser gang founded in 1962 by Joe Ganci at the intersection of Thorndale and Kenmore in the Edgewater neighborhood on Chicago's North Side. The gang formed partly in response to rising crime and neighborhood blight in eastern Edgewater, and by 1964 was among the most feared greaser gangs in the Uptown area. TJO was involved in racial conflicts at Senn High School beginning in 1971 and was estimated at roughly 200 members at its peak. Founder Joe Ganci was later imprisoned in the mid-1970s for crimes committed as a TJO member, after which he founded the Northsiders prison gang at Menard Correctional Center.
